name: assessing Artificial Intelligence Curriculum Enterprise demand
from: Original customer or Leader demand that the existing Artificial Intelligence Curriculum Enterprise has actually taken through the current Work Arena, still awaiting scoped assessment.
to: The lead either identifies a qualified existing book/worksheet/course/sample and source-owned delivery Work with named end-user receiving, or releases/declines it to the rightful home with its reason; buyer assent is never inferred.
cost: Bounded source qualification and Work attention; zero implied external expenditure.
otherwise: The underlying demand remains in its original Work standing with the first missing authority, source, recipient or capability edge; no parallel ticket or shadow sales record is minted.
receiver-condition: A distinct authorized original Work assayer receives or returns the lead's qualified service assessment; the lead cannot accept its own Work.
